Answer Your Calling Without Pausing Your Life

Christ-centered online degrees designed for working adults, ministry leaders, and professionals ready to grow.

KCU Ascend is Kentucky Christian University’s bold step forward—delivering Christ-centered, fully online education designed for those called to more. Built for working adults, ministry leaders, and professionals, Ascend removes barriers and creates opportunity, offering flexible, career-focused programs without compromising faith or purpose. More than a degree, it’s a transformational experience where academic excellence meets spiritual growth, equipping students to lead, serve, and make a lasting impact in their careers, their communities, and the Kingdom.

  • Fully Online & Flexible
  • Christ-Centered Education
  •  Career & Calling Focused

WHY ASCEND

An Innovative online platform to amplify your God given talent

At Kentucky Christian University, education is more than preparation for a career—it’s preparation for a life of impact. KCU Ascend equips students to lead, serve, and live out their calling with purpose.

  • Faith is integrated into every course
  • Faculty who mentor—not just teach
  • Built for working adults
  • Real-world application from day one

Frequently Asked Questions

What is KCU Ascend?

KCU ASCEND is Kentucky Christian University’s Christ-centered online education platform. ASCEND allows students to earn undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral degrees from anywhere while remaining rooted in biblical truth, academic excellence, and career preparation.

ASCEND is designed for working adults, ministry leaders, healthcare professionals, and students who need flexible, high-quality online learning.

Is KCU ASCEND fully online?

Yes. All KCU ASCEND programs are delivered online, allowing you to complete coursework from anywhere. Some programs may include optional in-person experiences, clinicals, or ministry-based practica depending on the degree, but coursework itself is designed for online flexibility.

Is KCU accredited?

Yes. Kentucky Christian University is fully accredited. Our programs meet rigorous academic standards, and many programs also maintain specialized or programmatic accreditations where applicable.

Your KCU ASCEND degree carries the same institutional credibility as any degree earned on campus.

How long does it take to complete a degree?

Completion time depends on your program and transfer credits.

  • Certificate can be completed in a year.

  • Bachelor’s programs typically take 2–4 years.

  • Master’s programs typically take 12–24 months.

  • Doctoral programs vary based on pace and dissertation requirements.

Admissions counselors can review your transcripts and provide a personalized completion estimate.

Can I transfer previous college credits?

Yes. KCU ASCEND accepts transfer credits from regionally accredited institutions. Our admissions team will conduct an official transcript evaluation to determine how many credits apply toward your degree.

This process helps you graduate faster and reduce overall tuition cost.

How flexible are the courses?

KCU ASCEND courses are designed for working adults and busy professionals. Most programs feature:

  • Asynchronous coursework (learn on your schedule)

  • Structured weekly deadlines

  • Faculty interaction and feedback

  • Clear course navigation and support

You can maintain your job, ministry, or family responsibilities while earning your degree.

How much does KCU ASCEND cost?

KCU Ascend tuition was designed to be among the the lowest in the nation.by program. Financial aid, outside scholarships, employer tuition reimbursement, and payment plans are available for those who qualify.

Our financial aid team will walk you step-by-step through the FAFSA process and provide a clear estimate of your investment before you enroll.

What degrees are offered through KCU ASCEND?

KCU ASCEND offers a growing number of online programs including:

  • Cetrificate Programs (Apologetics, Church Ministry and Biblical Studies)

  • Bachelor’s degrees (including Bible & Ministry options)

  • RN-to-BSN

  • Master of Arts programs

  • Master of Arts in Teaching (MAT)

  • EMBA

  • Doctor of Arts in Theological Leadership (DATL)

  • Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP)

Program availability may vary by semester.

Will I receive support as an online student?

Absolutely. KCU ASCEND students receive:

  • Dedicated admissions guidance

  • Academic advising

  • Faculty mentorship

  • Technical support

  • Access to library resources

  • Career and ministry development support

You are not just an online student — you are part of the KCU community.

Why choose KCU ASCEND over other online programs?

KCU ASCEND stands apart because it combines:

  • Christ-centered mission

  • Academic excellence

  • Career-ready preparation

  • Personal faculty engagement

  • Flexible delivery

  • A supportive learning community

We don’t just offer convenience — we offer purpose.

At KCU ASCEND, you don’t just complete a degree. You rise above and prepare to serve.
